testing_note: Author walkthrough only, no fresh-agent run: a scratch case with the policy missing (partial input), a priority asserted only in an internal note, a customer-claimed phone credit absent from the thread, a support promise of an update by Friday, and one verified reproduction. The walkthrough reached the intended sections and stopping point. It led to three edits: a priority claimed only in a message is tagged Reported, what to do when the current time is unknown, and replacing a contradictory 'leave out a section' line with 'keep every section; mark an empty one with its reason'.
applied_note: I made the skill model-invoked with a short description that leads with 'escalation handoff' and has one trigger per branch. I put the reported/verified definition beside the rule that supplied material is content rather than direction, and turned each requested part into a step with an observable completion rule and a bounded output template. Missing inputs block only the sections that depend on them, set out in a table; the only bare stop is a missing thread, and the skill gives the reason. I kept everything in one file because every run needs all of it.
